import pandas as pd
a=pd.read_csv('admissions.csv.gz',parse_dates=['admit_time','discharge_time'])
p=pd.read_csv('patients.csv.gz'); o=pd.read_csv('outpatient_visits.csv.gz',parse_dates=['visit_time'])
print(a.discharge_status.value_counts(dropna=False)); print(a.unit.value_counts())
print(p.family_id.notna().sum(), p.family_id.nunique(), p.age.describe())
print(a.admit_time.min(),a.admit_time.max(),a.discharge_time.max())
a=a.sort_values(['patient_id','admit_time'])
a['next']=a.groupby('patient_id').admit_time.shift(-1)
a['gap']=(a.next-a.discharge_time).dt.total_seconds()/86400
print('overlap/neg gap',(a.gap<0).sum(), 'gap0-1d',((a.gap>=0)&(a.gap<1)).sum(), 'readmit30',(a.gap<=30).mean())
# per patient admission span
span=a.groupby('patient_id').admit_time.agg(['min','max','count'])
print(span['count'].value_counts().head())
print(((span['max']-span['min']).dt.days).describe())
# follow-up end per patient? last observed time
last=pd.concat([a[['patient_id','discharge_time']].rename(columns={'discharge_time':'t'}),o[['patient_id','visit_time']].rename(columns={'visit_time':'t'})]).groupby('patient_id').t.max()
a['last']=a.patient_id.map(last)
a['fu']=(a['last']-a.discharge_time).dt.days
print('fu<30 days among non-readmits & not died:', ((a.fu<30)&~(a.gap<=30)&(a.discharge_status!='died')).sum())
print(o.groupby('patient_id').size().describe())
print(a.groupby('discharge_status').gap.apply(lambda g:(g<=30).mean()))
